title: Jesus... I Said One More Reel An Hour Ago
topic: she promises one more reel at 2 a.m. every night and hides her exhaustion at work

bible.text: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat—for He gives sleep to His beloved.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... it's 2 a.m. again. I said one more reel an hour ago, and I'll smile at work anyway. 📱

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your eyes hurt but your thumb keeps moving.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I stop, I have to think about my day.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: What is the day you're avoiding?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone got ahead of me and I just nod in meetings.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put the phone down. You can't fix it awake and empty.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Sleep is not laziness. It is a gift from Him.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who's still online at 2 a.m. What are you avoiding tonight? 👇
